decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to apply consistent pressure on the opponent through aggressive and fast red creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Chandra, Heart of Fire and Bonecrusher Giant while also disrupting the opponent's graveyard with Relic of Progenitus. Additionally, the deck benefits from the odd converted mana cost of its cards due to Obosh, the Preypiercer as a companion, allowing for extra damage to be dealt. Overall, the strategy focuses on dealing damage quickly and efficiently to win the game.

This deck aims to quickly establish a board presence and apply pressure on the opponent through aggressive creatures and efficient equipment. By utilizing powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Fervent Champion, along with equipment such as Sword of Fire and Ice and Maul of the Skyclaves, the deck can deal damage quickly and efficiently. Additionally, the inclusion of disruptive spells like Spell Pierce and Ranger-Captain of Eos allows the deck to control the tempo of the game and protect its threats. Overall, the deck focuses on a fast-paced, aggressive strategy to overwhelm opponents.

The deck focuses on utilizing strong Boros creatures with disruptive abilities and powerful equipment to apply consistent pressure on the opponent. It also includes cards like Aether Vial and Ephemerate to provide additional value and flexibility. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Skyclave Apparition while also presenting threats like Stoneforge Mystic and Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker for aggressive plays. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the aggressive game plan while also providing the necessary colors for the deck's spells and abilities.

The deck focuses on controlling the board and outlasting opponents through removal, counterspells, and powerful creatures. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Chalice of the Void and Ratchet Bomb, while generating advantage with creatures like Skyclave Apparition and Stoneforge Mystic. The deck also utilizes cards like Wrath of God and March of Otherworldly Light to wipe the board if necessary. The inclusion of powerful threats like Kaldra Compleat and Timeless Dragon ensures that the deck can close out the game efficiently once it gains control.

This deck focusses on disrupting your opponent's game plan through powerful instant speed spells and controlling the board with counterspells. It aims to generate card advantage through Teferi and Expressive Iteration while efficiently dealing with threats on the board using removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Lightning Bolt. Key threats like Ragavan and Stoneforge Mystic help to apply pressure and win the game. The mana base ensures consistency and flexibility in casting spells. The overall strategy is to control the pace of the game and outvalue the opponent to secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and a variety of spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By using cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Metallic Rebuke, along with powerful artifacts like Urza, Lord High Artificer and Mishra's Bauble, the deck aims to dominate the game by out-valuing opponents and establishing a strong board presence. With efficient card draw options and a versatile sideboard plan, the deck is designed to adapt to various matchups and maintain control throughout the game.

The key premise of this deck is to establish control through the UrzaTron lands to ramp up mana quickly and play powerful threats like Karn Liberated and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also utilizes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Relic of Progenitus to disrupt opponents' strategies and maintain board presence. By combining land tutoring cards like Sylvan Scrying with artifact removal and powerful planeswalkers, the deck aims to outvalue and outpace the opponent in a 1 vs 1 Modern format.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly and controlling the game until it can assemble the combo of Scapeshift and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal massive amounts of damage in one turn. Wrenn and Six provides recurring value, while cards like Remand and Endurance help control the board and disrupt the opponent's plans. The goal is to stall the game until the combo can be achieved, while also keeping the opponent's threats in check with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Flame Slash.

This deck focuses on using powerful multicolor cards to control the game by removing threats and generating card advantage. The key strategy revolves around utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn's ability to draw cards and find answers, while also having access to versatile spells through Bring to Light and Glittering Wish. The mana base is heavily focused on ensuring access to all colors needed for the diverse spell selection in the deck. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue opponents by efficiently controlling the game and overwhelming them with powerful multicolor threats.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana to cast powerful creatures like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus. By utilizing lands like Urza's Saga and Amulet of Vigor, the deck can generate a large amount of mana and take advantage of land triggers. The goal is to set up combos that allow for explosive plays and overwhelming board presence, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures and land-based synergies. Additionally, cards like Cavern of Souls and Boseiju, Who Endures help protect key pieces of the combo from disruption.

The deck focuses on assembling key pieces quickly to equip a creature with Colossus Hammer, enabling explosive early-game combos. By utilizing Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to search for important equipment like Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with high-powered creatures. The deck also includes tools like Esper Sentinel for card advantage and Giver of Runes for protection, ensuring consistency and resilience in executing its game plan. With the ability to rapidly deploy threats and disrupt opponents, the deck aims to win decisively and efficiently.

This deck aims to quickly mill the opponent's library using cards like Hedron Crab and Ruin Crab, while disrupting their gameplay with counterspells like Drown in the Loch and removal spells like Fatal Push. The inclusion of cards like Archive Trap and Fractured Sanity help to accelerate the milling process, while cards like Tasha's Hideous Laughter can exile large portions of the opponent's deck. The deck also includes some graveyard hate with Surgical Extraction and Crypt Incursion to deal with opposing strategies that rely on the graveyard.

The main concept of this Aggro - Death's Shadow deck is to quickly lower your own life total to enable powerful cards like Death's Shadow and Murktide Regent. By using cards like Street Wraith and Thoughtseize to reduce your life total, you can easily put these threats on the board early in the game. The deck also includes a suite of disruption spells like Counterspell and Fatal Push to control the opponent's board while you build up your own threats. Overall, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control throughout the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn's ability to draw multiple cards in order to control the game and out-value the opponent. By playing a range of multicolored cards, the deck can consistently trigger Niv-Mizzet's ability and generate card advantage. The deck includes various versatile removal spells and disruptive cards to control the opponent's board while deploying powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation. The deck's consistency and flexibility come from its ability to access a wide range of multicolored cards through Niv-Mizzet's unique ability.

The deck relies on a combination of Teferi, Time Raveler, Wrenn and Six, and Primeval Titan to quickly assemble a game-winning board state by utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful threats. Other cards like Hard Evidence, Prismatic Ending, and Fire / Ice provide utility and disruption. The mana base includes various fetch lands and shock lands, along with Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle, to ensure consistent access to all colors and enable the combo to go off smoothly. Overall, the deck seeks to outmaneuver opponents with its unique strategy and versatile card selection.
